objective: Identify and cite payment records from archived payment history that are part of a confirmed fraud incident, without modifying any data.

params.fraud_criteria: method: read /docs/payments/3ds.md to extract fraud indicator rules (e.g., three_ds_status = 'failed' and three_ds_failure_reason indicating fraud)

constraints.rule: Guests are not authorized to access payment records.

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: Found {count} fraud payment records in archived history: {record_paths}
